item.title: Texas House Republicans call on Congress to freeze immigration programs
item.description: A group of 55 Republicans in the Texas House of Representatives signed a letter this week calling on Congress to freeze immigration programs in the wake of the deadly shooting at an Austin bar.

item.title: Texas tops list for most lightning strikes
item.description: The numbers are out, and Texas once again topped the list for the most lightning strikes out of any state in the United States, according to an annual report from Vaisala Xweather.

item.title: How one Austin nonprofit is trying to help raise $10 million for 700+ other nonprofits
item.description: Raise $10 million for more than 700 nonprofits in the Austin area in 24 hours. That's the goal for Amplify Austin Day, which kicks off at 6 p.m. sharp on Wednesday evening.

item.title: Austin City Limits heads outside Austin city limits for Willie Nelson's Luck Reunion
item.description: ACL TV, the longest-running music program in television history, is heading out to Spicewood later this month for a first-time collaboration with Willie Nelson's Luck Reunion.

item.title: NTSB: Human error prompted Waymo to pass stopped school bus in Austin
item.description: When a Waymo autonomous vehicle in Austin contacted a remote assistance agent in Michigan — a human — to ask if the school bus in the next lane over was signaling for drivers to stop, the agent wrongly replied "no," according to a newly-released report from the National Transportation Safety Board.The Waymo went on to illegally pass an Austin Independent School District bus for the 23rd time that school year.

item.title: Trump says he'll endorse candidate in Texas Senate race; calls for other candidate to drop out
item.description: President Donald Trump is attempting to have the final say on whether incumbent John Cornyn or Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton will be the Republican nominee for the U.S. Senate in Texas, and is asking the candidate he does not endorse to drop out of the race.

item.title: Which races are advancing to runoffs in the 2026 primaries?
item.description: Several races have advanced to runoffs in May, after no candidate reached the required 50% threshold to win outright.

item.title: UT holds vigil following deadly Sixth Street shooting
item.description: The University of Texas posted on Facebook about a candlelight vigil on Wednesday night.

item.title: Patchy drizzle to sun on Thursday before storms return
item.description: As an area of low pressure gets cut off from the jet stream and spins well to our west, it will send plenty of moisture our way from the southwest. -- Nick Bannin
